techpack.notes: Labadeh: ankle-length clerical over-robe. Edge-to-edge front without buttons, closed by a hook at the collar and hidden hooks to just below the waist. Stand collar, shoulders and chest interfaced. Long set-in sleeves. One-piece skirt with no hem vents; pocket-access slits in both side seams. Fully lined (lining not modelled).

Labadeh: ankle-length clerical over-robe. Edge-to-edge front without buttons, closed by a hook at the collar and hidden hooks to just below the waist. Stand collar, shoulders and chest interfaced. Long set-in sleeves. One-piece skirt with no hem vents; pocket-access slits in both side seams. Fully lined (lining not modelled).

Aba: sleeveless open cloak in light wool, worn over the robe and 60 mm shorter. Straight sides (cloth fold) closed from the arm slits to the hem; 360 mm arm slits at the top of each side; long shoulder line sloping 40° with the arm; open front, no closure; narrow braid along the neck and front edges.
